svg.title: Step 4 polish 07: the one rule for the hero
svg.text: 07 · The hero uses the screen: one rule for every hero template
Replaces the hero scale of mockup 20 with a rule the build can follow. Book shots R1, R2, R17–R22, S1–S3, A5. Frames at 1080p, drawn at 50 % and 22 %.
A · No photo: one block, centred both ways

g.text: Orders close at 20:00 · Lost and found at the info desk · Grand final on stage tonight
safe area: the hero less 64 px

svg.text: B · With a photo: the photo fills the hero, the text sits on a scrim

g.text: Orders close at 20:00 · Lost and found at the info desk · Grand final on stage tonight
the photo covers the hero; crop from the centre

svg.text: C · The scale at 1080p
Every size doubles at 4K; portrait uses the same steps on its narrower hero
Kicker
44 px, capitals, spaced, in the template’s colour
Headline
160 px (128 px over a photo), down by 4 to fit, never under 88 px; two lines (three in portrait)
Body
60 px down to 44 px; one line if it fits at 44 px, else two
Meta
40 px in the primary ink: a time, a place, a link
Countdown
330 px figures under a 88 px title (full screen: 420 px)
Sting
230 px extra-bold (full screen: 300 px), dark ink on the theme’s gradient
The block is measured, then centred: one block, never pinned to a corner. A template only fills the slots it has;
an empty slot takes no space.
D · Before and after
The shipped look (left, from the book) next to the rule (right)

svg.text: Before · S1: the sting

g.text: Orders close at 20:00 · Lost and found at the info desk · Grand final on stage tonight

svg.text: After
The rule
One content block, centred across and down in the hero less 64 px.
With a photo: the photo fills the hero, the block sits centred at its foot on the scrim.
Without one: large centred type; never small text in a corner of an empty hero.
Stings: the hero turns to the theme’s gradient, primary to accent, with dark ink and a light sweep.
Full-screen steps (Midnight, Premiere’s countdown) follow the same rule on the whole frame.
Ink is computed per ground (design decision 1); storyboard steps join the readability check.
